privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal information Dokan collects when you use our store, how we use it, and the choices you have.

collect.title: Information We Collect
collect.body: We collect the details you give us, such as your name, email address, phone number, delivery address and order history. We also collect basic technical data, such as device type and pages viewed, to keep the store running smoothly.

use.title: How We Use Your Information
use.body: We use your information to process orders, deliver purchases, send order updates, answer support requests and, if you opt in, send offers. We do not sell your personal data.

storage.title: Data Storage
storage.body: Your account and order data are stored securely using Supabase, a hosted database and authentication service. Access is limited to the systems and staff that need it to run the store.

cookies.title: Cookies and Local Storage
cookies.body: We use cookies and browser storage to keep you signed in, remember your cart, wishlist and language, and keep applied coupons during your session. You can clear these at any time in your browser settings, although some features may stop working.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.body: You can access, correct or delete your personal information, withdraw marketing consent and ask questions about how your data is handled. Contact our support team and we will respond within a reasonable time.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: By using the Dokan website and placing an order, you agree to the terms below. Please read them carefully.

orders.title: Orders
orders.body: An order is confirmed only after we receive payment and send a confirmation. We may cancel orders due to limited stock, pricing errors or suspected fraud, and any amount you paid will be refunded.

pricing.title: Pricing and Payment
pricing.body: All prices are shown in the store currency and may include applicable taxes. Discounts and coupons cannot be combined unless stated, and coupons are valid only for the period and conditions shown.

returns.title: Returns and Refunds
returns.body: Most items can be returned within 14 days of delivery if they are unused and in their original packaging. Refunds are issued to the original payment method after the item has been checked.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.body: Dokan is not liable for indirect or incidental losses arising from the use of the store. Our total liability for any order is limited to the amount you paid for it.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Quick answers to the questions we hear most often. Can't find what you need? Visit our Contact page.

shipping.a: Standard delivery usually takes 3 to 5 business days. Express delivery is available at checkout for faster arrival in selected areas.

returns.q: How do I return an item?
returns.a: Go to My Orders, select the item and choose Return. Items must be unused and in their original packaging within 14 days of delivery.

payment.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
payment.a: We accept major credit and debit cards and the other payment methods shown at checkout. Your payment is processed securely.

coupons.q: How do I use a coupon code?
coupons.a: Enter your code in the coupon field on the cart page and select Apply. Coupons are valid for one order unless stated otherwise, and stay applied until you remove them or clear your cart.

account.q: Do I need an account to shop?
account.a: You can browse as a guest, but you need an account to check out, save your wishlist and view your order history.

tracking.q: How can I track my order?
tracking.a: Sign in and open My Orders to see the current status of each purchase. You will also receive updates by email.

cancel.a: You can cancel an order from My Orders while it has not shipped yet. Once it has shipped, please use the return process instead.
